mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2.0%, which is consistently true in the current economic environment, the compression of discount rates in a low-inflation setting drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0% (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When both real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) are rising above their 3-month moving averages, it indicates strong consumer demand and housing market resilience, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both above their 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST are above their 3-month moving averages (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: In the low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to strong labor market conditions and sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) rises above 110, it indicates strong manufacturing activity and robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO > 110 (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).
